listed_quote.quote: (“KIO”) (NYSE: KIO) and the Board of Trustees of Insight Select Income Fund (“INSI”) (NYSE: INSI)

announcement.quote: today announced the signing of a definitive agreement under which KIO will acquire the assets of INSI.

deals.notes: Press release dated October 8, 2024, filed as 425 on 2024-10-09. The shown excerpts of the later filings (DEF 14A 2025-02-14 is an annual meeting for trustee elections; 8-K 2025-10-31 is an officer change; DEF 14A 2026-02-13) do not state whether the vote passed or the reorganization closed, so the outcome is null.
